interface.name: zwp_text_input_v3
interface.description: The zwp_text_input_v3 interface represents text input and input methods associated with a seat.

request.name: enable

description.summary: Request text input to be enabled

request.description: Requests text input on the surface previously obtained from the enter event.

request.name: disable

description.summary: Disable text input on a surface

request.description: Explicitly disable text input on the current surface.

request.name: set_surrounding_text
request.description: Sets the plain surrounding text around the input position.

request.name: set_text_change_cause

description.summary: indicates the cause of surrounding text change

request.description: Tells the compositor why the text surrounding the cursor changed.

request.name: set_content_type
request.description: Sets the content purpose and content hint.

request.name: set_cursor_rectangle
request.description: Marks an area around the cursor as a x, y, width, height rectangle in surface local coordinates.

request.name: commit
request.description: Atomically applies state changes recently sent to the compositor.

event.name: enter
event.description: Notification that this seat's text-input focus is on a certain surface.

event.name: leave
event.description: Notification that this seat's text-input focus is no longer on a certain surface.

event.name: preedit_string
event.description: Notify when a new composing text (pre-edit) should be set at the current cursor position.

event.name: commit_string
event.description: Notify when text should be inserted into the editor widget.

event.name: delete_surrounding_text
event.description: Notify when the text around the current cursor position should be deleted.

event.name: done
event.description: Instruct the application to apply changes to state added by the preedit_string, commit_string and delete_surrounding_text events.

interface.name: zwp_text_input_manager_v3
interface.description: A factory for text-input objects. This object is a global singleton.

request.name: get_text_input

description.summary: create a new text input object

request.description: Creates a new text-input object for a given seat.
